check_jacobians_list: check that a list of torch tensors is empty before populating jacobians
get_module: import a Python module dynamically by its string name using __import__
get_cls_module: get the module of a given class by inspecting its __module__ attribute
shape_err_msg: generate an error message describing a tensor shape mismatch for a given data type
fill_dims: prepend unit dimensions to a torch tensor to reach a target number of dimensions
